text: Figure 7.16: Parallel ActionListItem execution and SYNC Please note that parallel execution of the ActionListItems is heavily dependent of the implementation and the underlaying hardware and operating system. As - together with the "SYNC" ActionListItem - Function Group State dependencies can be realized, the referenced Function Groups can be given in an arbitrary order to fulfill the project-specific needs.
